summary: I checked current Bitcoin and Ethereum prices against today's price-threshold markets, lineup and injury news for tonight's Italy-Turkey, France-Belgium, Sweden-Romania and Northern Ireland-Georgia Nations League games, and the Elon Musk tweet count trackers. Bitcoin is trading right around 86,000 dollars and Ethereum right around 2,700 dollars, so the thresholds near those levels are already fairly priced, and the far thresholds (84,000 and 88,000) only offer a one to two point edge after fees, not enough. Turkey's missing players against Italy and Mbappe's absence for France are both several days old and already reflected in prices, Sweden and Romania are both missing key players so that match looks balanced, and I could not reach the tweet tracker site to get a live Elon Musk post count. No market cleared the 5 point edge bar after fees, so I am holding all positions with zero trades this cycle.
